subject.title: Switcher rows “Weekly progress” uses the primary/session quota

question: Should the existing `Weekly progress` switcher option be corrected to prefer each provider’s weekly quota, or should it retain primary-quota behavior and be renamed to describe that behavior?
rationale: Commit `11f4cc8d13419f9b8f2147bd81a00decaa7ec439` appears to have intentionally selected primary quotas, while the current setting label promises a weekly metric; source inspection cannot safely choose between these product semantics.

options.title: Honor the weekly label
options.body: Prefer an actual weekly quota window when a provider exposes one, with the existing primary quota as an explicit fallback when it does not.

options.title: Keep primary quota semantics
options.body: Retain primary/session quota selection but rename the option and clarify the metric in the settings UI.

recommendation.title: Honor the weekly label
recommendation.body: Prefer an actual weekly quota window when a provider exposes one, with the existing primary quota as an explicit fallback when it does not.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant core usage-selection behavior is tied to the identified prior switcher change and requires a product-contract decision.
